description: Every place and experience the in-game album counts (Union Station, the PATH, subway stations, streets and landmarks), each with a short description. Read-only.

kind.description: place = somewhere you walk to; experience = something you do (ride the subway, take a taxi); all (default) = both.

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en (English, default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

underground.description: true = only places below street level (PATH, subway, train concourses); false = only street level; leave out for both.

name: list_places
title: Places to find in Toronto Walk
